title: TWESE CHW AI: the three-minute demo
note: Fictional patient on synthetic data. The Swahili SMS reading changed from 150/95 to 138/88 on 4 October (demo step 3: no threshold crossed yet); the wording is unchanged - the bilingual teammate checks it before recording.

steps.title: Offline start
steps.say: WiFi is off. Everything runs on this laptop.
steps.expected: Dashboard lists 60 synthetic patients (one CHW); banner: thresholds not yet physician-approved. Patient 1 is medium tier: a borderline flag (readings 130, 132, 135, 136 just under 140/90), her WHO 10-year risk, and on this data a peer-trajectory flag. She is already on the weekly SMS watch, which is why she texts.

steps.title: A patient texts in Swahili

message.text: Habari. Leo presha yangu ni 138/88. Nimekunywa nusu ya dawa tu. Nina maumivu ya kichwa.
message.gloss_en: Hello. Today my blood pressure is 138/88. I took only half of my medicine. I have a headache.

steps.expected: Intent bp_report; fields sbp 138, dbp 88, meds_taken partial, symptoms [headache]; all checks pass; the CHW taps Confirm.

steps.title: The flag: no threshold crossed yet
steps.expected: Trend flag: each of the last three readings (135, 136, 138) at least 10 mmHg above her baseline of 125. Borderline flag: readings in a row in the band just under 140/90. Headache at goal, half dose. Show her chart: every reading still under 140/90 while the line climbs. Risk tier moves from medium to high.
steps.say: No threshold has been crossed yet. This is the patient the tool is for.

steps.title: Suggested action and override
steps.say: The text moved the rule's answer one step, and the screen quotes the words that did it. The CHW still decides; the override is stored and reviewed.
steps.expected: Suggestion visit_this_week: the rule default is recheck_7_days (trend, borderline, headache at goal), and the context code missed_doses, quoted from her SMS ("nusu ya dawa"), steps it up one level. The CHW steps back down to recheck_7_days, reason 'patient travelling, weekly SMS continues'; the override is stored and becomes a review card in step 7.

steps.title: The education question
steps.expected: After Sync the danger-signs question arrives on the phone; the reply 2 is wrong; the correction is queued; the CHW taps Send and it appears on the phone; danger-signs understanding drops to 0 and risk points are added.

steps.title: The weekly plan
steps.expected: Patient 1 now has a visit this week in the Kirundo group; the CHW moves one patient and approves the plan. Emergencies are not in the plan; they are on the escalation list.

steps.title: The monthly review
steps.say: Every missed event and every override becomes a review card that a person labels. Thresholds move only after a replay shows what the change would have caught and what it would have cost. A person pressed this; the model never updates itself.
steps.expected: The review queue shows the override from step 4 (visit_this_week down to recheck_7_days) as a candidate false positive, and synthetic patients whose event had no prior flag as false negatives with their pre-filled cause (in the demo data: 'extraction', a headache in the CHW note that was never coded). The supervisor labels both (PIN). Replay a lower trend threshold (POST /errors/replay with trend rules +7 over three readings and +10 over four): it shows which past events it would have caught and how many more contacts it would have flagged. Then the engine retrains, shows the new model version and its held-out score, and the next suggestion carries the new version.

steps.title: Languages
steps.expected: Switch the interface to French, then Swahili. Stored data does not change. Kirundi is marked not yet verified.

notes_for_presenter: Escalation list: 3 patients. Severe BP without symptoms is an urgent clinic referral in 2 days, not an emergency.
GET /escalation?lang=fr shows the protocol text in French.
